+import asyncio
+import os
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Callable, Optional
+
+import httpx
+
+
+OPENAI_AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions"
+
+
+async def stream_audio_chunks(
+    source: AsyncIterator[bytes],
+    on_chunk: Optional[Callable[[bytes], None]] = None,
+    chunk_size: int = 4096,
+) -> None:
+    api_key = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
+    buffer = bytearray()
+
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0, headers=headers) as client:
+        async for data in source:
+            buffer.extend(data)
+            while len(buffer) >= chunk_size:
+                chunk = bytes(buffer[:chunk_size])
+                del buffer[:chunk_size]
+                if on_chunk is not None:
+                    on_chunk(chunk)
+                await client.post(
+                    OPENAI_AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION_URL,
+                    data={"model": "whisper-1"},
+                    files={"file": ("chunk.wav", chunk, "audio/wav")},
+                )
+
+        if buffer:
+            chunk = bytes(buffer)
+            if on_chunk is not None:
+                on_chunk(chunk)
+            await client.post(
+                OPENAI_AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION_URL,
+                data={"model": "whisper-1"},
+                files={"file": ("chunk.wav", chunk, "audio/wav")},
+            )
+
+
+async def _main() -> None:
+    async def source() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        yield b"\x00" * 8192
+        yield b"\x01" * 2048
+
+    await stream_audio_chunks(source())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    asyncio.run(_main())
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: stream_microphone.py
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import sys
+from typing import Iterator, Optional
+
+import pyaudio
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+class MicrophoneTranscriptStreamer:
+    def __init__(self, model: str = "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe", sample_rate: int = 16000):
+        self.client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+        self.model = model
+        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
+        self._audio_queue: "queue.Queue[Optional[bytes]]" = queue.Queue()
+
+    def _audio_source(self) -> Iterator[bytes]:
+        while True:
+            chunk = self._audio_queue.get()
+            if chunk is None:
+                return
+            yield chunk
+
+    def stream(self) -> Iterator[str]:
+        try:
+            with self.client.audio.transcriptions.stream(
+                model=self.model,
+                file=self._audio_source(),
+                response_format="text",
+            ) as stream:
+                for event in stream:
+                    event_type = getattr(event, "type", None)
+                    if event_type in {"transcription.delta", "transcript.delta"}:
+                        delta = getattr(event, "delta", None)
+                        if delta:
+                            yield delta
+                    elif event_type in {"transcription.completed", "transcript.completed"}:
+                        text = getattr(event, "text", None)
+                        if text:
+                            yield text
+        finally:
+            self._audio_queue.put(None)
+
+    def run_microphone(self, chunk_size: int = 1024, channels: int = 1, format=pyaudio.paInt16) -> Iterator[str]:
+        p = pyaudio.PyAudio()
+        stream = p.open(
+            format=format,
+            channels=channels,
+            rate=self.sample_rate,
+            input=True,
+            frames_per_buffer=chunk_size,
+        )
+        try:
+            for _ in self.stream():
+                pass
+        finally:
+            stream.stop_stream()
+            stream.close()
+            p.terminate()
+
+    def enqueue_audio(self, data: bytes) -> None:
+        self._audio_queue.put(data)
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    streamer = MicrophoneTranscriptStreamer()
+    p = pyaudio.PyAudio()
+    mic = p.open(
+        format=pyaudio.paInt16,
+        channels=1,
+        rate=16000,
+        input=True,
+        frames_per_buffer=1024,
+    )
+    try:
+        while True:
+            audio = mic.read(1024, exception_on_overflow=False)
+            streamer.enqueue_audio(audio)
+            for transcript in streamer.stream():
+                sys.stdout.write(transcript)
+                sys.stdout.flush()
+    except KeyboardInterrupt:
+        return 0
+    finally:
+        mic.stop_stream()
+        mic.close()
+        p.terminate()
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
